AI YouTube Video skill initial release.

- Automates editing and exporting of YouTube-ready videos from raw footage (supports MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, up to 500MB).
- Integrates with Nemo Video cloud backend for fast (1–2 min) AI processing and 1080p MP4 export.
- Automatic authentication and session setup; 100 free credits with anonymous access.
- Handles common video edits via natural language prompts (e.g., trim silences, add subtitles, optimize).
- Organized API actions for upload, edit, export, and status checks.
- Supports workflows for quick edits, batching, and iterative refinement.
